definitions.explanation: A period of rest or relaxation.
Time when one doesn't work or attend school.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みに{何|なに}をしますか。
examples.english: What will you do during summer vacation?

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{休|やす}みです。
{昼休|ひるやす}みは{十二|じゅうに}{時|じ}からです。

notes: From the verb {休|やす}む. Common compounds: {夏休|なつやす}み (summer vacation), {冬休|ふゆやす}み (winter vacation), {昼休|ひるやす}み (lunch break), {春休|はるやす}み (spring break). お{休|やす}み (goodnight) is a common greeting.
